 Manchester weather forecast: Sunny intervals and 95% chance of rain on October 19, 2026 
 Oct 19, 2026, 10:56 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Latest weather update and forecast for Manchester. Manchester, October 19, 2026, is experiencing a day characterized by significant weather changes. The forecast reveals a combination of sunny intervals contrasted by a high chance of rain throughout the day. Temperatures are expected to reach a maximum of 15°C, with a low of 10°C, while humidity is expected to hover around 92%. With a 95% chance of rain, residents should prepare for possible disruptions to outdoor plans today. Manchester Weather Today
 Today's weather in Manchester presents a mix of conditions, beginning with sunny intervals that may offer brief moments of respite from overcast skies. The daytime temperature will peak at 15°C, making it feel relatively mild for October, although the cooler low of 10°C tonight suggests that residents should dress accordingly. Humidity levels are notably high at 92%, which may contribute to a muggy feel as the day progresses. The forecast indicates a significant chance of rain, at 95%, pointing toward potential rainfall later in the day. While no specific precipitation amounts are provided, residents should remain vigilant to stay dry. Wind conditions, with gusts reaching up to 41.84 kph, may also impact outdoor activities, especially for those planning to spend extended periods outside. Despite the promising sunny intervals, the clouds are expected to dominate as the day unfolds. Notable changes in weather patterns will likely occur in the late afternoon, when rain showers could become more prevalent, making it essential for residents to keep an eye on the skies. Umbrellas and waterproof footwear advised
 Given the high likelihood of rain today, Manchester residents are advised to bring umbrellas and wear waterproof footwear if they plan to be outdoors. Those with appointments or engagements should consider adjusting their plans, especially if they include outdoor activities. The uncertain weather could necessitate last-minute arrangements, so being prepared for wet conditions will ensure a smoother day. As afternoon temperatures drop, now is a good time for Manchester residents to consider indoor plans or at least have a backup option for their evening activities. Staying hydrated remains vital despite the cooler conditions this afternoon. Manchester Weather for Upcoming 7 Days

 Following today, Manchester is set to experience several days of variable weather. The week will start with increasingly cooler temperatures and a steady chance of rain. Notably, October 24 is forecasted to be the wettest day with heavy rain expected, while October 25 will follow with light showers. The warmest day is projected to be October 24 as well, with a high of 14°C. Overall, residents can expect a mixture of light showers and rain throughout the week, with little respite from wet conditions. Those planning outdoor endeavors should prepare for possible cancellations or delays due to rain. In conclusion, as weather conditions shift, it will be essential for residents of Manchester to stay updated and prepared for wet conditions throughout this week.
